---
title: "`r params$title`"
report-class: model
output:
  html_document:
    self_contained: true
    md_extensions: "-native_divs-native_spans"
  pdf_document:
    latex_engine: xelatex
  word_document: default
params:
  title:         "Model report"
  model_name:    ""
  model_desc:    ""
  image_file:    NULL
  config_df:     NULL
  discount_df:   NULL
  horizon_plot:  NULL
  calendar_plot: NULL
  calendar_df:   NULL
  geoscale_df:   NULL
  counts_df:     NULL
  comm_df:       NULL
  sup_df:        NULL
  dem_df:        NULL
  trd_df:        NULL
  expimp_df:     NULL
  weather_df:    NULL
  policy_df:     NULL
  cns_df:        NULL
  windows_plot:  NULL
  techs:         NULL
header-includes:
  - \usepackage{booktabs}
---

```{r setup, include=FALSE}
library(ggplot2)

# Shared helpers live in the package (see ?energyRt::report_helpers).
fmt <- energyRt::report_setup()
tbl <- function(df, caption = NULL, digits = 4L)
  energyRt::report_tbl(df, caption, digits, output = fmt)
emit_img <- function(path, frac = 1)
  energyRt::report_img(path, frac, output = fmt)
```

```{r css, results='asis'}
energyRt::report_css(fmt)
```

```{r logo, results='asis'}
if (!is.null(params$image_file)) emit_img(params$image_file, 0.25)
```

`r if (isTRUE(nzchar(params$model_desc))) params$model_desc`

## Processes

```{r techs, results='asis', fig.width=6, fig.height=4}
for (tt in params$techs) {
  cat("\n\n### ", tt$name,
      if (!is.null(tt$class) && nzchar(tt$class))
        paste0(" (", tt$class, ")"),
      if (nzchar(tt$desc)) paste0(" --- ", tt$desc), "\n\n", sep = "")
  emit_img(tt$draw_file, 0.7)
  cat("\n")
  tbl(tt$info_df)
}
```
